# Synchronous hook fixture

Project-authored shell fixture, distributed under the repository license. No upstream source is copied and no credentials or user content are included.

`capture.sh` receives JSON on stdin, writes it only under PLUGIN_DATA, records PLUGIN_ROOT and cwd, and exits 1. The test expects session_id, turn_id, tool_use_id, model, permission_mode, hook_event_name and tool_input from the host-owned ToolUseContext. Original package contents remain unchanged.

Reference snapshot: codex-rs/hooks/src/engine/command_runner.rs (run_command_hook), hooks/src/schema.rs (PreToolUseCommandInput), hooks/src/events/pre_tool_use.rs (parse), hooks/src/events/model_request.rs (observation-only), hooks/src/output_spill.rs (HookOutputSpiller). Exact source digests are recorded in docs/plugin-compat/evidence/t34.json. Oversized output and timeout scripts are generated by the independent Rust tests.
